verses.text: Ha spuertail Jericó te wach' yaj smakchaji yujto xiw heb' t'a heb' israel. Yuj chi' malaj junok mach syal yelta, ma tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Ha in ol wak'och jun chonhab' tik t'a yol a k'ab' yet' winh sreyal yet' heb' winh soldado.
E masanil ex soldado israel ex tik, junjun k'u ol ex ek' oyoyok junelok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' tik, wake' k'ual ol he k'ulej icha chi'.

Ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote sb'ab'laj t'a yichanh te' skaxail trato, junjun heb' yet'nak junjun sch'aak, b'ob'il t'a sch'ak nok' kalnel. Haxo t'a yukil k'ual jun, ukel ol ex ek' oyoyok t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', ol spu'annhej nok' ch'aak chi' heb' winh.

Haxo yik tzeyab'ani to sb'atkan numan sjaj nok' sch'ak heb' winh chi' spu'ani, te chaanh tzex awaji, haxo yem lanhnaj smuroal chi'. Slajwi chi', junjun ex tzex b'at t'a eyichanh yik tzex och t'a yol chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix yawtankot heb' winh sacerdote winhaj Josué chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ol eyik'b'at te' skaxail strato Jehová. Tzex b'ab'laj ukwanhok ex t'a yichanh te', tzeyik'anb'at junjunok nok' he ch'aak, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ol b'at ex ek' oyoyok junelok t'a spatik jun chonhab' tik. B'ab'elokab' sb'at heb' winh soldado t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' masanil tas ix yal winhaj Josué chi': B'ab'el sb'at jun makan heb' winh soldado yet' syamk'ab'. Slajwi chi' tzak'an ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote wan spu'annhej sch'aak. Tzak'anpax heb' winh sacerdote b'akhjinak te' skaxail strato Jehová. Haxo t'a spatik heb' winh tzak'an junxo makan heb' winh soldado.
Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' t'a heb' winh soldado chi' to malaj junok heb' winh tz'el yaw, ma sloloni, masanto a winh ol alanok, ichato chi' te chaanh ol el yaw heb' smasanil.

Ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' to tzek' oyoyok heb' yet' te' kaxa chi' junelok t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winh yet' masanil heb' anima t'a campamento. Hata' ix ek' ak'wal yuj heb'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, te ak'walto ix k'e waan winhaj Josué chi', ix b'at ek'xi oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi'. B'ab'el sb'at jun makan heb' winh soldado yet' syamk'ab'. Tzak'anpax ukwanh heb' winh sacerdote spu'an nok' ch'aak, max och waan heb' winh spu'an nok'. Tzak'anpax heb' winh sacerdote b'akhjinak te' skaxail strato Jehová. Haxo t'a spatik heb' winh tzak'an junxo makan heb' winh soldado.

Ha t'a schab'il k'ual chi' hanheja' junel ix ek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajpax heb' winh t'a scampamento, ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh t'a wake' k'ual.
Haxo t'a yukil k'ual, te ak'walto ix k'e waan heb' winh, ix b'atxi heb' winh junelxo. Ukel ix ek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a jun k'u chi'.

Haxo t'a yukelal, ayik toxo ol spu sch'ak heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix yalan winhaj Josué chi' t'a masanil heb' winh soldado: Ayik ol eyab'an sb'atkan numan sjaj nok' sch'ak heb' winh sacerdote tik, chaanh tzex awaji, yujto toxo ix yak'och jun chonhab' tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab'.

Masanil jun chonhab' tik yet' masanil heb' anima ayek' t'a yol chi', toxo ix yal Jehová to masanil heb' ol satelok, anhej ix Rahab, ix ajmul ix, manh ol satel-laj ix yet' masanil mach ayek' yet' ix t'a yol spat, yujto a ix, ix k'ub'anel heb' winh ix ulek' yil jun chonhab' tik kuuj.

Scham eyab'ani, ayta wal junok tas ay t'a jun chonhab' tik tzeyama', ma tzeyik'b'ati, yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to masanil satjieli. Tato ay tas ol eyama', ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' t'a kib'anh ko masanil, ol onh lajwokel yuj.
Anhej k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronce yet' k'een hierro, a juntzanh chi' tz'ochkan yikok Jehová, skan b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'ay, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.

Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix spu'an nok' sch'aak heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix b'atkan numan sjaj nok'. Ayik ix yab'an heb' winh soldado chi', te chaanh ix el yaw heb' winh smasanil, yuj chi' ix em lanhnaj smuroal jun chonhab' chi'. Elanhchamel, junjun soldado ix b'at t'a yichanh b'aj ayek' heb' chi', ix och heb' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix laj smilancham masanil anima heb' ay t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Eb' winh winak, heb' ix ix, wach'chom ichamtak anima, ma unin, nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' b'uru, masanil ix satel heb'.

Yalnakxo winhaj Josué t'a heb' winh chawanh xit'nakek' yil jun chonhab' chi' t'a sb'ab'elal to sb'at yik'elta ix ajmul ix chi' heb' winh yet' heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat, icha aj yalannakkan heb' winh t'a ix.

Yuj chi' elanhchamel ix b'at heb' winh. Ix b'at yik'anelta ix heb' winh t'a yol spat chi' yet' smam snun, heb' snulej ix yet' masanil heb' ayto yuj sb'a ix yet'ok yet' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a jun lugar t'a spatikel campamento.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al jun chonhab' chi' heb', ix tz'ab'at masanil tastak. Anhej tastak b'ob'il t'a k'een plata, k'een oro, k'een bronce, ma k'een hierro ix yik'b'at heb', ix sik'anb'at heb' b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'chaj t'a Jehová.

Anhej ix Rahab yet' smam snun yet' heb' ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok maj satel-laj yuj winhaj Josué chi', yujto kolwajnak ix t'a heb' winh xit'nakek' yil jun chonhab' chi' t'a sb'ab'elal. Atax ta' ix kan ix yet' yinhtilal t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan jun lolonel tik winhaj Josué: katab'ajokab' yuj Jehová mach sb'oanxik'e jun chonhab' tik t'a schaelal, chamokab' sb'ab'el unin ayik tz'em yich, chamokab'pax stzak'an unin ayik tz'och spuertail, xchi winh.
Ix kolwaj wal Jehová yet' winhaj Josué chi', te niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a masanil juntzanh lugar chi'.
